journey.title: Tabbing out of the navigation closes the open dropdown
journey.goal: After a keyboard user leaves the navigation, the Shop dropdown no longer covers the page

steps.title: Tab out of the navigation to search

functionalJourney.title: Open the Shop dropdown with the pointer

guards.title: Escape closes the Shop dropdown and returns focus to Shop
guards.goal: Escape inside the dropdown closes it

plan.root_cause: The disclosure menu does not close when keyboard focus moves outside the menu via Tab, leaving the dropdown open and covering page content.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a focusout listener on the root menu element that closes the associated controller (toggle) when focus leaves the menu and the controller is open, while ensuring focus movements inside the menu (e.g., from button to menu item) do not trigger a close.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When a user tabs out of the navigation, the Shop dropdown will close, preventing it from obscuring underlying content and restoring the expected state (aria-expanded="false" and #plants hidden).
functional_risks: Incorrectly closing the dropdown when focus moves from the button to a menu item (mitigated by checking that the relatedTarget is not inside the menu).
Attempting to close when the controller is null or not open (guarded by conditional checks).
verification_requirements: After fixing, tabbing from the Shop button to the search input should result in aria-expanded="false" on #shop and #plants hidden.
Opening the dropdown via Enter should still work and allow navigation inside the dropdown with Tab.
Shift+Tab from the first menu item back to the button should keep the dropdown open.
Clicking outside the menu with the mouse should continue to close the dropdown (existing behavior unchanged).
